## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run changelog:bump -- <patch|minor|major>` and the new `CHANGELOG.md` section describes this change (CI fails without it)
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] Every page I touched checked in the browser, on light and navy grounds
- [ ] No hard-coded colours, sizes or fonts; nothing copied from the design system (AGENTS.md → What you must not do)
- [ ] Unconfirmed facts wrapped in `<Ph>`; no moved URL without a redirect
